clues: This city stands on the River Seine in the west of Europe. Its old streets by the river are a World Heritage Site.
Winters here are cool and grey, with rain in all months of the year. Hard frost is rare, since the sea air keeps the cold mild.
Clovis, a Frankish king, made this city his capital in the year 508. The city stayed the seat of kings for a long time after that.
A tall iron tower went up for a great fair here in 1889. Top artists of the day panned its design, but now the world loves it.
The president of France sits in this city. Both houses of its parliament sit here too.
